rules.BOUNDED_LIVE_IMPACT: Reachable only from bounded roots in independently verified complete dependency evidence.
rules.CRITICAL_LIVE_IMPACT: Reachable from a critical operational root, including transitive dependencies.
rules.NO_LIVE_IMPACT: No changed paths, or Markdown proven unreachable in independently verified complete dependency evidence.
rules.UNKNOWN_IMPACT: Incomplete dependency evidence, unresolved dynamic references, or unclassified component.

unknown_policy: Require all critical and bounded gates; never promote from classification alone.
